2609.29433.title: Detecting Glaucoma Across Multi-ethnic Myopic and Non-Myopic Populations Using an Uncertainty-Aware Vision Transformer: A Multicentre Model Development and Validation Study
2609.29433.paper_summary: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based glaucoma detection from colour fundus photographs (CFP) offers scalable screening, but performance may decline on external datasets because of differences in ground-truth definitions, populations, and coexisting conditions such as high myopia (HM). We developed and validated a Vision Transformer-based deep learning (DL) model for glaucoma detection across multi-ethnic cohorts with and without HM. Methods: A ViT-B/16 model with predictive uncertainty estimation was developed using 56,483 CFPs (57.1% with myopia; 14.4% with HM). Glaucoma labels were standardised using clinical, imaging, and perimetry data. The model was validated on 16 independent datasets across three continents, including four datasets with explicit HM labels. Findings: Internal AUROC was 98.7% (95% CI 98.2-99.1%), with sensitivity 94.5% and specificity 97.3%. Across 16 external datasets from eight countries, AUROCs ranged from 86.4% to 99.6%. In HM eyes, internal AUROC was 97.8% (95% CI 96.1-99.2%), with sensitivity 94.8% and specificity 93.7%. External HM AUROCs were 86.5% in the Beijing Eye Study and 93.3%, 91.8%, and 85.5% in hospital-based datasets from Taiwan, Thailand, and South Korea. In an exploratory HM clinical evaluation, the model had higher CFP-only diagnostic accuracy than ophthalmologists and trained graders (92.0% vs 70.0%; p=0.008) and performed comparably to glaucoma specialists using full clinical information. Interpretation: The model showed robust glaucoma detection across myopic and non-myopic multi-ethnic populations and may support AI-assisted screening in settings with high HM prevalence.
2609.29433.paper_summary_zh: 背景：基於人工智慧（AI）的青光眼檢測從彩色眼底照片（CFP）提供可擴展的篩檢，但由於真實標準定義、人口和共存條件（如高度近視（HM））的差異，性能可能在外部數據集上下降。我們開發並驗證了一種基於視覺Transformer的深度學習（DL）模型，用於在有和沒有HM的多民族隊列中進行青光眼檢測。方法：使用56,483張CFP（57.1%為近視；14.4%為HM）開發了一個具有預測不確定性估計的ViT-B/16模型。青光眼標籤使用臨床、影像和視野檢查數據進行標準化。該模型在三大洲的16個獨立數據集上進行了驗證，包括四個具有明確HM標籤的數據集。結果：內部AUROC為98.7%（95% CI 98.2-99.1%），敏感性為94.5%，特異性為97.3%。在來自八個國家的16個外部數據集中，AUROC範圍從86.4%到99.6%。在HM眼中，內部AUROC為97.8%（95% CI 96.1-99.2%），敏感性為94.8%，特異性為93.7%。外部HM AUROC在北京眼科研究中為86.5%，在來自台灣、泰國和南韓的醫院數據集中分別為93.3%、91.8%和85.5%。在一次探索性HM臨床評估中，該模型的CFP僅診斷準確率高於眼科醫生和訓練評估者（92.0%對70.0%；p=0.008），並且在使用完整臨床信息的青光眼專家中表現相當。解釋：該模型在近視和非近視的多民族人群中顯示出穩健的青光眼檢測，並可能支持在高度HM流行的環境中進行AI輔助篩檢。
